title: Evening Murmuration deploy cadence and rollback cheatsheet
content:
Purpose:
Quick reference for 'evening murmuration' deploys — short-window, regional-rolling, low-risk changes that we ship between 18:00–22:00 PST for non-urgent feature rollouts. This doc is a lightweight cadence + release notes draft + rollback cribsheet; keep it compact so on-call can scan fast.

Status: draft. Use for Thursday/Friday evening micro-waves only. Not for database migrations or schema changes that require broad coordination.

High-level cadence (weekday evening wave):
- T-72h: Preflight ticket created; owner assigned; smoke plan stubbed on PR. Link ticket in Slack #deploys.
- T-24h: Canary config prepared, 1% traffic, telemetry queries written, rollback steps validated in staging.
- T-2h: Final smoke test run; ops/SE on call notified; release notes (below) pasted into ticket.
- T: Rollout start — apply 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 15–40 minutes depending on heat. Stop on signal.
- T+30m: Post-smoke validation and quick retro notes.

Preflight checklist (must pass before T-2h):
- PR merged to release branch or hotfix tag created.
- Nightly canary artifact built and checksum verified.
- Configs: routing policy and model variant pins reviewed.
- Load test: sample replay ~5k requests in staging; no >5% error spike.
- Tracing: distributed tracing enabled for this change, sampling bumped to 1%.
- Observability: dashboards pinned, telemetry queries saved, alert thresholds set.
- Communication: #deploys status pinned, pager rotations set for 3 hours.

Canary thresholds (abort if any triggered):
- 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 3 minutes vs baseline.
- P50 latency increase >40% or P95 >100% absolute ms increase.
- Token cost/unit anomalous >1.5x historical.
- Error funnel increase for customer-facing endpoints (>2x).

Ramp plan (example):
- 00:00 (T): 1% traffic for 5m. Quick smoke tests.
- +5m: 5% for 10m. Run end-to-end flows.
- +15m: 20% for 10m. Medium load validation, KV cache warm.
- +25m: 50% for 5m. Watch for tail latency, memory pressure.
- +30m: 100% if all green. If any threshold trips, rollback immediately to previous model/tag.

Rollback cheat sheet (fastest path):
- If using tag-based artifacts: point router back to previous tag (router rollback script: scripts/flip-router.sh <previous-tag>).
- If using model variant fallback: set routing policy weight 100% to stable-variant.
- If infra-level issue: trigger autoscale-shutdown for broken pool and route to fallback region.
- Post-rollback: capture span IDs, error traces, and attach to ticket, then run simple replay to confirm anomaly resolved.

Release notes (draft — paste to ticket and #deploys):
- Title: evening-murmuration: small model variant tweak + batching opt (2026-12-10)
- Summary: Reduce p99 latency for conversational flows by adjusting batching window and KV cache warm heuristics. No schema changes.
- Impact: Hosted API, Dedicated pools in us-west1. Expected <1% transient error rate during rollout.
- Rollout strategy: staged canary 1->5->20->50->100 over 30m with telemetry gates.
- Rollback: router flip to tag v2026-12-03-stable if thresholds breach.
- Runbook link: CON-1234

Smoke test matrix (quick):
- Auth/sign-in flow: 5 successful end-to-end requests with expected tokens and no 5xx.
- Streaming completion: client stream intact, first-byte latency within historical P95.
- Embeddings endpoint: cosine similarity sanity check against golden set (5 samples).
- Cost check: monitor per-token billing meters for 10 minutes; alert if >1.3x.

Telemetry queries to run (saved queries names):
- release_evening_murmuration_error_rate
- release_evening_murmuration_latency_breakdown
- release_evening_murmuration_token_cost_delta

Immediate post-deploy actions (T+30m):
- Short retro notes in the ticket: one-line summary, any flaps, action items.
- If green: mark release ticket as "done" and add to weekly digest.
- If rollback: open incident brief template, notify Customer Success for any affected customers.

Open questions / things to tidy before using as canonical runbook:
- Should we add an automated throttle that pauses ramp on P90 increase vs baseline? (Jenna working on proposal)
- Finalize exact sampling rate for tracing to avoid costs.
- Confirm Dedicated pool fallback region for us-west1 (Omar to confirm).

Notes to self: Keep this short. This doc is intentionally terse — link to the long-form release runbook when executing migrations or cross-team launches.

Relevant links: Confluence: CON-1234, Jira: JIRA-8765, PR: github.com/redwood-inference/release-scripts/pull/432

-- Aisha T. (on-call coordinator)
